description: Synthetic, not captured: two decks play while the crossfader sweeps from the left (deck 1) to the right (deck 2), the master follows to deck 2, hamster inverts, deck 1's fader drops, the crossfader is disabled, deck 2 is ejected and reloaded (nothing of the mixer is resent) and taken off the crossfader. Wire format, framing and the delta semantics of the VDJ 8.5.9307 captures; crossfader values as captured (a number 0..1); leftcross, rightcross, crossfader_hamster and crossfader_disable follow the VDJScript verb list and await a live capture.
note: t = ms; rx data is raw, unparsed

label: sweep the crossfader to the right in tenths, one value per write
hamster on: the crossfader at the right lets deck 1 through
crossfader to the middle, then deck 1's fader to 50%
eject deck 2 while playing: no fader, crossfader or side is resent
reload the same file on deck 2: title, bpm and loaded only
